decisive_baseline: Fresh Bernoulli node-vector CMCL with the own-loss floor and exactly the same coefficient, but auxiliary gradients applied to all parameters; also vanilla CMCL and no-assignment uniform penalty.
implementation_qualification_needed: Complete TRAIN responsibility scope, literal loss scaling, stable Bernoulli uniform KL, fixed tie policy, native output LayerNorm coupling, private-only VJP/optimizer ownership, AMP/RNG/buffer replay and all extra costs.
relationship: Proposed graph shared-core ordinary own BCE plus CMCL only through private-factor gradient blocks is a bounded adaptation; no posterior, teacher, input-conditioning or new pooling claim.
source_discrepancy: Prose reverses KL orientation; printed Eq3, §4.2 derivation and Algorithm1 use uniform-to-predictive KL.
title: Confident Multiple Choice Learning
verified_operation: CMCL minimizes per-example assigned prediction loss and KL(U||P) for unassigned members; assignment cost includes leave-one-out uniform penalties. Exact-gradient and stochastic-uniform-label alternatives. Random cross-member lower-layer feature sharing is also direct prior.
